user_query: I'm a car enthusiast and I'm looking for a reliable source to purchase car parts at affordable prices. Can you suggest an online platform that offers a wide range of car parts? It would be great if the platform allows users to download their app for easy access to their products.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of popular online platforms that sell car parts at affordable prices, focusing on user reviews and platform reliability.
Filter the list of platforms to find those that offer a mobile app for easier access and purchasing.
Provide the user with the final recommendations of online platforms that meet the criteria.
